carried_by: the resource cost manifest of a streamed world's assets: a versioned companion of a pack, named by the SHA-256 of its own bytes
header: magic (4), version 1 (u32), rows 1 to 64 (u32), row bytes 440 (u32), the cost model's digest (32 bytes: SHA-256 of the model revision's name)
row: spec version (u32), format (u8, 1 up to packed_vertices48), category (u8), backend (u8), 0 (u8), side (u32), the content's digest (32 bytes), thirteen u64 cost words, then the row's dependencies
rules: the file is exactly the header and its rows
the model digest is one this reader knows
the reader is given the manifest's digest and refuses bytes that don't hash to it

fixture.source: one resource of four index bytes with no dependencies (format-profile.coax fp_manifest, written by resource_manifest_write)
